title: Dungeon Totems of Undying
summary: A new set of 14 totems can now be found along the train. They will still save your life, mostly.
highlights: Evokers are in on it too.
description:
A new set of 14 totems can now be found along the train. Custom made for this modpack. They will still save your life, mostly...

Some might turn you against your friends, others may turn you into a cow, wolf, llama or more. Some might have you think zombification is better than death... if you can turn back.

What else awaits after these totems? The train has the answers.

*Shout out to Lil Detective Crunch (mc: AntonioMacarely) for the idea and help designing this addition to the pack.*
